extracted.name: Grammy's Easy Blackberry Cobbler
extracted.description: This easy blackberry cobbler dessert is simple to put together with just three ingredients: sweet and juicy fresh blackberries, cake mix, and butter.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Spread blackberries into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Place cake mix into a large bowl. Mix in butter until mixture resembles cornmeal; sprinkle mixture evenly over blackberries.
Bake in the preheated oven until blackberries are bubbling and topping is golden brown, about 30 minutes.
